description: He wears an opaque deep-purple knee-length open-front coat with broad gold geometric and floral woven borders, fastened by small paired gold-toned chest clasps. A cream long tunic beneath has a decorated short open collar and trimmed hem. A brown-and-gold woven belt has a round central buckle. Brown trousers tuck into tall brown boots. Layers have dense wool-like and linen-like textures; exact fiber composition is unverified. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
